blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) and the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) have lifted the temporary ban on Discord. That is after the messaging platform committed to implementing stronger child safety protocols and counter-extremism measures. The decision followed a meeting between Philippine officials and senior Discord executives, including the platform’s Asia-Pacific public policy directors. READ: DICT, gov’t cybercrime center confirm Discord ban has been lifted During the discussions, Discord pledged to address government concerns regarding nihilistic violent extremism (NVE), grooming, the radicalization of minors, and threats related to violence in schools and communities.
